Dialogs.Dialog: Have I been getting too clingy with you？
It's a little late to ask, but it just doesn't feel very much like me.
Being like ▲小早川＊▲ just means ▲小早川＊▲ doing whatever she wants, right？
If ▲小早川＊▲ wants to be with ●, then that's all that matters, right？
Guess I can't help it. Being with you is fun.
Honestly, I want to stay with you so much longer.
Having to part ways every day once it gets late... I wish we could stay longer.
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. I actually won a prize. An overnight trip to Atami.
●... Just the two of us. Want to go？
About the trip... Okay. ...I'll go with you.
O-oh, got it. Um, when should we go？
(Well, we can always go on our date another time.)
Alright. A two-day trip starting on ▲月▲ ▲日▲!
(● and ▲小早川＊▲... Our first trip together, huh.)
I actually won a prize. A trip to Atami.
...Really？ You didn't secretly buy them yourself, did you？
I didn't! Anyway, that's why I was hoping you'd go with me.
Yeah. ...I'm happy. So, when are we going？
Let's see, we'll have our date on another day...
Alright. A two-day trip starting on ▲月▲ ▲日▲!
(I get to go on a trip with ▲小早川＊▲!)
I'm going shopping for the trip, so come with me. Right now, obviously.
For the trip？ Right, we need to get ready... Alright, let's go!
Meet me at the mall, then.
You haven't even thought about it？
You're older and wiser, so show me what you've got.
(Wait. We're going on a summer beach trip, so...)
I need to buy a swimsuit!
If anything comes up, I'm counting on you.
"Probably" doesn't cut it. We're in this together, you know.
Come on, don't be so dramatic.
Thanks for coming with me. It really helped.
Make sure you pack ahead of time, okay？
Rare for me in spring, huh？ I just happened to wake up early.
Morning. Sorry to keep you waiting.
It's hot! Is it any cooler where we're going？
Morning. I don't think it will be.
Guess you'd call this perfect weather for a trip？
So cold... If it's freezing there too, I'm going straight home.
Hey, come on. Tough it out a little.
Well, just felt like it. ...What do you think？
Whatever. I didn't expect a clever answer anyway.
...Try putting yourself in my shoes before saying that.
(Yeah, the old way was definitely better.)
(Yeah, ▲小早川＊▲'s outfit today is really nice.)
Ugh, now I want to take it off.
(Yeah. I think ● looks better in other stuff.)
What do you think？ Personally... I like it.
I won't judge your taste, but... read the room, would you？
(Yeah, the old way was definitely better.)
(Yeah, ▲小早川＊▲'s outfit today is really nice.)
(Yeah. I think ● looks better in other stuff.)
Yeah, did it just for today. Does it suit me？
And I worked so hard on it...
(Yeah, the old way was definitely better.)
Does my outfit look weird today？
Hehe, you can say more, you know？
(Yeah, ▲小早川＊▲'s outfit today is really nice.)
Well, as long as it's not weird.
(Yeah. I think ● looks better in other stuff.)
(Come to think of it, today is...)
Hey, you didn't forget just because of the trip, right？
Our transfer's that way. You really didn't look anything up, huh.
There's two of us, so it's inefficient not to split up the work, right？
(And what's ▲小早川＊▲'s share of the work？)
My little brother's really into trains, you know.
Ah, I get that. He's at that age, huh. Photos, models, stuff like that.
Guess so. You don't get it, ▲小早川＊▲？
It's that way, I told you. Did you forget？
Can't forget what I never bothered to remember.
Unlike the bullet train, this has real charm to it.
Why so black and white？ Everything has its place.
Didn't I leave it with the chaperone？
Stop making stuff up. And I'm not your chaperone.
What do I do... Is this bad？
Worst case, we might have to pay extra.
Don't look at me when you say that.
Your ticket fell right there. Under your girlfriend's seat.
Oh, you're right. Thank you so much. You're a lifesaver.
(...She's polite to strangers, huh. Which is a good thing, but...)
Apparently Atami used to be the go-to honeymoon spot.
...Nothing. Just sharing a random piece of trivia.
You know, pretending we're newlyweds for the trip.
Well, we don't have to if you don't want to.
(What was she trying to get at？)
We will soon be arriving in Atami. Thank you for riding with us today.
Come on, get ready. This is our stop.
Nothing. Just thinking, so this is Atami.
Since when are you a regular here？
Come on, ●, this place is full of memories for us.
Now then, what should we do first？
Riding the train wears me out.
It's a bit early, but let's take a break and grab lunch.
Great view, isn't it？ Just don't lean out too far.
Then why don't you lean out for me？ Come on, aren't you gonna walk on the railing？
No way am I doing that！
Well, you were eating potato chips on the train.
Not eating potato chips on a long trip goes against my principles.
I don't know about this. Male chauvinism？ Good grief.
Well, it kind of looks that way. How does the story go again？
The author died before finishing it, so it's incomplete.
Oh, really？ Leave it to a library committee member.
You're on the committee too. Anyway, do me a quick favor.
I know where this is going. You're gonna kick me!
What's the big deal？ It's a small price to pay to get the full Atami experience.
What kind of sightseeing is that...?
Man... Now my kicking foot feels all unsatisfied.
Maybe I should blow off some steam. Is there an arcade around here？
We didn't come all this way to go to an arcade. Not that I've seen any around here.
Whenever I visit somewhere new, I get the urge to take on the locals, though.
Hold on, wait! You're giving up way too fast!
I can't even see the top. This is ridiculous.
Come on, we can just take our time.
Don't you want to give me a piggyback ride？
And you call yourself a healthy high school boy？
Let's just turn back. We won't have the energy left to go anywhere else.
The leaves are turning red up top. Sigh... They really ought to build an escalator.
So much for taking in the atmosphere...
The air is so clear up here. Maybe it feels that way especially after exercising？
Not that you'd know, ▲小早川＊▲, since you didn't exercise.
Good job. Carry your girlfriend up these stairs and you're a real man.
The autumn leaves are so pretty. It was worth all the trouble climbing up here.
Yeah, they really are. Though ● did all the hard work.
Well, just to follow tradition, should we pray while we're here？
Yeah, might as well since we came all this way.
(I hope ▲小早川＊▲ and I grow even closer.)
(What's this？ I feel like I've gotten closer to ▲小早川＊▲ than before!)
I feel like it's actually doing something. Is this one of those "power spots"？
Okay, I'm gonna go change. Wait here for me.
Yeah, right. See you in a bit.
(Hmm. Even looking around, ▲小早川＊▲ really is the cutest girl here.)
Yeah, now that's what I'm talking about.
So this is all a summer trip is to you？ Talk about a one-track mind.
I wore the swimsuit you asked for, you know？
That's right. You oughta just be grateful.
(Come to think of it, is ▲小早川＊▲ using any sun protection？)
You need to put on some sunscreen!
Tanning oil is the way to go!
▲小早川＊▲, shouldn't you put on some sunscreen？
Guess there's no helping it. I'll put it on for you.
Tanning oil？ Huh, so that's what you're into.
I bet a tanned ▲小早川＊▲ would be cute too! Should ● put it on you？
Yeah, yeah, I get it. Just don't come near me.
This really feels like a man-made beach.
You don't have to be so cynical about it.
I don't mean it in a bad way. There's no rule saying man-made is worse than natural, right？
That's right. What matters is who's by your side at the time, right？
Hey, aren't there a lot of cherry trees around here？
They're what you call Atami cherry blossoms.
So would the ones in Towano be Towano cherry blossoms？
Never heard of 'em, but they could use that to promote the town.
Like souvenir buns and that sort of thing？
Then with the extra tax money, maybe our school gets better facilities too？
(It's a private school, though... I'll stay quiet.)
Texting？ You've been on it on and off for a while now.
What, does it bother you when I look at my phone while we're together？
Just keeping a little record of our trip.
(Well, I guess it can't be helped.)
You're taking way too long, ▲小早川＊▲!
Just a little longer. We still have time, right？
Yeah, but... the sooner we get to the hotel, the more time we'll have to ourselves...
Oh, it really is a ropeway.
Yeah, all the way to the top.
As if. Come on, we're going, right？
Whoa, it's moving. Pretty fast, too.
Hey, can I point something out？
We didn't have to ride this to get to the top, you know. We could've taken a bus.
Well, yeah, but... this is more fun!
I guess... Depends on who you're riding with, hehe.
They say if a couple puts a lock here, they'll be happy forever.
A love lock... Is that why they call it Aijou Cape？
You got it. Let's do it!
It goes against my principles, but... oh well, I guess.
(She always has to complain first, huh.)
Didn't they collect it for the shrine already？
The gods sure have it rough, dealing with everyone's love lives all the time. Gotta hand it to them.
(Not that ● and I are any different.)
Hey, what about over there？ Aren't we going in？
Uh... It's not really on the schedule.
Should we at least grab a pamphlet？
I might've said this before, but...
Why is it that couples like high places so much？
Who knows. Though you and I sure like high places too, ●.
True. Especially night views and stuff...
Should we head to the hotel soon？
Let's get some rest first thing when we arrive.
Yeah, I'm going to sleep. Maybe.
N-Nothing. ...Anyway, are you really okay with this？
Staying the night together like this. Even though it's our first time.
Have you gotten used to this kind of thing yet？
I have a reservation under ▲苗字▲...
Right this way to your room.
Please allow me to take your bags, ma'am.
What an adorable wife you have.
You know, I was thinking. Do hotel staff really need to carry our bags？
Isn't it a waste of labor？ I can carry my own stuff.
And what's with calling me 'adorable'？ What am I, some kind of small animal？
(So she's purposely ignoring the 'wife' part, huh.)
What's going on with the rooms？
I'm sure I booked separate rooms, though...
They said there was a mix-up. Looks like they don't have any other rooms open either. What a pain.
No way! I'll go talk to them again.
I'm saying it's fine to share a room.
I mean, we came on this trip together. Getting separate rooms would be weird. I want to be together anyway.
Somehow, it feels weird just taking sharing a room for granted.
What, would you rather have separate rooms for a change？
I'd hate that even more. ...That's why I'm putting up with it.
Haha, you always check that first. I get it, I get it.
And what goes with snacks？ Come on.
Tea, right. All right, I'll make us some.
Thanks. I'll make it for you next time.
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Let's go explore the hotel.
Sure. Looking for retro arcade games？
Right to the games, huh？ I mean, I'm down for that too.
And if there's a slightly run-down lounge or something, that'd be perfect. Think they have one？
What about karaoke？ Or a sauna？ For some reason, I'm getting really excited.
(I never know what's gonna get her excited...)
I'm thirsty. Gonna go get some juice.
See you. Don't get sidetracked. And don't get lost.
Hmm. 4,500 yen for a 40-minute massage, huh... Way out of a high schooler's budget.
▲小早川＊▲ left her wallet behind. Man, talk about being a kid.
(Oh, what should I do about the key...？)
Idiot! Why the heck is the door locked？ Hurry up and get back here!
Sorry, I thought I'd find you right away. You forgot your wallet, right？
I just took some change with me. Hurry up and unlock the door.
(No way she went outside... Guess I'll head back for now.)
What are you wandering around for？
You forgot your wallet, right？ So I went after you.
Huh？ Obviously I just took some change with me.
Just how far did you go looking for me？
We still have time before dinner. Let's take a bath first.
？ Looks like this hotel has all kinds of baths, and the men's and women's sides switch depending on the time.
Right now, the men's is the Roman bath, and the women's is the flower bath, huh.
I'd rather try the Roman bath... Whatever, waiting around is a pain anyway.
Where we both go to the baths, and wait for each other after getting out.
Oh, yeah, should we do that？
Nice. Today, I'm straight out of a folk song.
Alright, I'll wait for you here when I get out.
(We walked around a lot today, so I should relax.)
(I bet ▲小早川＊▲ is still in there...)
Did you soak all the way up to your shoulders？
And count to ten while you were in there？
Two seconds is plenty! I hate hot baths.
(Note to self: ▲小早川＊▲ takes short baths...)
By the way, that yukata looks pretty good on you.
Hmm. Is that supposed to be a compliment？
Of course. It really suits you.
Wait, are you okay with sashimi, ▲小早川＊▲？
You just seem like you wouldn't like it, for some reason.
I eat it. I'm a cat, after all.
Let's rest for a bit, then...
Oh yeah, I saw something online earlier.
There's this island called Hatsushima you can take a boat to from Atami Port.
Apparently there's a legendary beach there that no one's ever reached.
If you pledge your love there, you'll be happy forever... Ugh, I feel silly just saying it.
Huh, first I've heard of it.
I kinda want to go check it out.
No one's ever been there, right？ Sounds exciting.
Wanna try looking for it tomorrow, then？
Yeah, let's do it. Hatsushima it is tomorrow.
You know, that place. The legendary one.
Yeah. Not that it's a typical tourist spot, though.
Good idea. Let's try looking for it again...
Oh, they have a ping-pong table here.
Aw, don't be like that. Come on, let's play.
Yeah, yeah. Just don't try too hard, okay？
Why'd you go all out？ What an idiot.
(▲小早川＊▲ was going pretty hard too, though...)
I just took a bath, and now I'm all sweaty again.
You couldn't even make me get serious... Are you really an old man？
(Oh, there's an open-air bath. Maybe I'll ask ▲小早川＊▲ to go with me.)
(I just took one earlier. I'm good on baths.)
▲小早川＊▲, let's hit the open-air bath!
An open-air bath？ Nah, too much trouble.
I see... Then I'll pass too, ●.
An open-air bath... Huh, that might be nice.
(The snow is piling up... It must have been snowing without me noticing.)
Yeah, when did that start？ I didn't notice at all.
Hey？ I told you not to shout.
Uh, yeah... Well, it is an open-air bath.
▲小早川＊▲! How is it over on your side？
Stop it already. What if someone else comes in？
Besides! I can't relax when I can hear your voice!
I heard there's a private bath... Want to try it？
Really？ Okay, I'll head over first.
(A private bath... That means a family bath. ...What should I do?)
I should be a man and...
(So this is the family bath... Where's ▲小早川＊▲？)
What's wrong？ Aren't you getting in？
What are you staring at, perv？
You totally were, you dirty old man.
...Just kidding. A bath in swimsuits is pretty nice too, right？
(Thank god... I was almost branded a total pervert.)
Idiot! Pervert! What the heck were you thinking？
People outside will hear! ● will get out!
(Come to think of it, ▲小早川＊▲ said something about the night view.)
Invite her for a night walk
(It's already dark out, I'd better not.)
▲小早川＊▲. Want to go for a night walk？
Earlier today, when we looked out over town, didn't you mention the night view？
I did, but... never mind. It's too much trouble.
I see... you're right. Got it.
I did. Hehe, you actually remembered that.
A walk at night... Hehe. Kind of exciting.
That's nothing new for you though, is it, ▲小早川＊▲？
It's a bit far, but let's walk there.
It's just... better than I imagined. ...It's annoying.
Getting all moved by a night view... isn't really my style.
Well, anyway, does that mean you're satisfied？
▲主人公＊▲. Sounds like they're doing fireworks.
Oh, right. It's summer, and we're by the sea.
What do you want to do？
Hmm, sorry, I'll pass. Let's skip it.
It really is different from the Towano fireworks.
Obviously. It's a different fireworks show...
There are so many people, I can't see.
▲主人公＊▲. I heard they light up the beach here.
Oh, the beach？ I wonder what that's like.
Want to go check it out？
Hmm... Being indifferent makes you age faster, you know.
It really is lit up. So this is how it looks.
You mean a 'normal girl' would？ Drop that way of thinking already.
There are all kinds of girls out there, but you only have one girlfriend.
▲小早川＊▲, let's head back to the room soon.
(I see, this is definitely a little nerve-wracking.)
Hey... Should we turn off the lights soon？
Still... you're not going to sleep yet, right？
Good morning. Did you sleep well last night？
You startled me. Did we oversleep？
...Oh？ I'm so sorry. It seems I got the time wrong.
(I'm glad I woke up early. I got plenty of sleep last night, after all.)
(Maybe I'll just watch for a little while...)
Hehe, how long were you planning on sleeping？
Oh, morning... Isn't there a more normal way you could wake me up？
We still have time, right？ Can I snuggle up to you？
(Well, she's cute, so I guess it's fine...)
Hey, I need to get changed？
I'm not an exhibitionist, you know.
Oh, you are done. Let's go get some food, then.
(She was already done, so what's the big deal？)
When it comes to hotel breakfasts, it's gotta be a buffet.
I guess so. You don't have to eat anything you hate.
Don't you mean you get to eat whatever you like？
It's not the... Wait, is it？
Worrying about the little things will make you age faster.
That's what happens when you don't pay attention while you eat.
Hey, go get me another one？
Alright, let's go. We should get ready to leave soon.
That was a pretty nice hotel, huh？
Today's Hatsushima. I wonder if we'll find the legendary beach.
The legendary beach. I wonder if we can get there again.
We'll have to take a boat to Hatsushima from here.
I hope I don't get seasick.
Hmm, so this is what it looks like inside.
Well, guess I'll just take it easy.
You're not going out on the deck？
Guess ●'ll go when I feel like it, too.
You don't have to hold back for me. Go have fun out there.
It's not like I'm dying to go run around out there.
Man, it really does feel nice out here.
Oh, so you came out after all.
Look at the birds. Funny how they can keep up with a moving boat.
More potato chips？ You're gonna ruin your appetite for lunch.
It's fine, they're good. And no, you can't have any.
Yeah, yeah. Just don't make a mess.
Haha, guess the chips drew them in.
These are mine! Wait, never mind that, they're actually pretty scary!
You'll be fine. They look friendly enough.
Friendly where!? They've all got the eyes of a hunter!
Just shut up and help me!
Thanks. Here, you can have the chips as a thank-you.
Are you really insulting nature right off the bat？
That's not an insult. What's wrong with being small？ Got a problem with me or what？
Now you're just twisting my words... Anyway, let's get something to eat.
You want to eat here？ How come？
...Well, fair enough. Looks pretty good though. Let's head in.
Ramen, after coming all this way？ Want the shrimp ● got？
It's rock seaweed ramen, so it's fine. Give me the shrimp, though.
Well then, I wonder if we'll find that legendary beach.
Well, we can take our time looking for it.
Oh, it says something about a legend.
Aren't we going to pray or anything？
Huh, you can climb up the lighthouse.
My dad said there aren't many lighthouses open to the public.
Oh yeah？ Does your dad know a lot about them？
Yeah, apparently he's a lighthouse buff. So, want to climb up？
Sure, why not. I can brag about it to my dad.
Whoa, amazing. You can see in every direction.
Well, let's stay like this for a little while.
Right？ We're worn out from the trip, too.
We can't find the legendary beach...
Maybe it's a legend because no one can find it...
Even without finding the beach, ● had fun. Did you, ▲小早川＊▲？
I really do. Come on, this way.
The beach was supposed to be around here, right？
The sound of waves... ● can hear it too.
Wasn't the beach supposed to be around here？
Forget it. It's not like I wanted to go that badly...
The legendary beach... Is this it？
Must be. It really isn't on the map.
That thing about swearing our love to each other.
I, Rinko Kobayakawa, swear to love you forever.
I, ▲苗字▲▲名前▲, swear to love Rinko Kobayakawa forever.
Wait, have we been together nonstop since yesterday？
Well yeah, we're on a trip together.
My heart hasn't stopped pounding this whole time.
It's been like this ever since then.
My heart's been racing nonstop ever since...
And I just keep falling for you more and more.
I just can't stop loving you.
But I want to see what's ahead for us, too.
So give me more of your love, too...
This is it, right？ The legendary beach.
Must be. It's not even on the map.
Wow, amazing... So it really is real.
I, Rinko Kobayakawa, swear to love you... forever.
I, ▲苗字▲▲名前▲, swear to love Rinko Kobayakawa forever.
We've been together nonstop since yesterday, huh.
Yeah, that might be a first for us.
You'd think it'd be okay to get tired of each other after all this time...
...Actually, there's no way I'd ever get tired of you.
All I can think is how I want to be with you more.
That I never want us to be apart.
Yeah, I feel the same way.
And yet we still have to go home？
I know it can't be helped, though...
I'll put up with it for now. But when we're older...
Yeah... I love you... I want to kiss you.
So this is the legendary beach...
Yeah. It's not even on the map.
It really does exist... It's so... pretty.
Hey, I want to do it.
I told you, right？ Swearing our love here.
I, Rinko Kobayakawa, will love you forever.
I, ▲苗字▲ ▲名前▲, swear to love Rinko Kobayakawa forever.
It's the first time we've been together this long...
We grew up a little, didn't we？
I wonder how much older we have to get.
Before we don't have to go back home.
Did I put you on the spot？
Never mind. I'm having plenty of fun already.
Just being with the one I love makes me happy.
I love you. I have ever since back then.
One more time, just like back then...
I love you... Let's kiss, okay？
Yeah... Our special place full of memories...
What's on your mind right now？
I'm thinking about the first time we came here.
Yeah... I guess you are too, ●.
Do you also know what I want to do next？
Nnn. I guess our trip is almost over.
Must be worn out. Hang in there just a little longer.
We still have a bit of time before our train.
Want to look at souvenirs before we go？
Who are you buying them for？
Just for my family is fine.
I don't have friendships that fall apart just over not buying souvenirs.
Can't tell if that's cool or just an excuse...
It's fine. Besides, buying souvenirs is hard.
I told you, I'm bad at this. I'm not confident in my taste in souvenirs.
(What a weird thing to be self-conscious about.)
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Did you get pretty tanned？
Really？ I hope it doesn't start hurting.
I'm pretty wiped out. I might fall asleep.
You slept way too hard. We almost couldn't get home.
My bad. Though if we're talking about sleeping hard, ▲小早川＊▲, you too...
You're supposed to pretend you didn't see that.
I wonder how long the two of us were together.
Well, about a day and a half, right？
Just a day and a half, and it's like this...
What do you think would happen if we stayed together longer？
Though I have a pretty good idea.
Hehe, it's a secret. Nothing bad, though.
Sorry for making you walk me home.
Don't worry about it... Sigh, it's all over now.
Um... I want to go again.
Yeah, me too. Let's go again sometime.
Sigh, time to say goodbye... Bye-bye.
(Come to think of it, today is...)
Don't tell me you're just going home. You're forgetting something important.
(Walking home alone after a trip... It's kind of sad.)
Hello？ Where are you right now？
I'm almost at that convenience store.
Hey, mind if I look through your bag？
Some of my stuff might've gotten mixed in.
Is it really that important？ What is it？
Don't ask about stuff like that.
(She's gone. So much for our bittersweet goodbye...)
Hmm. Guess this is about what I expected.
There's no way I'm not having fun.
I mean, I want to be with you.
Well, I'm glad we came, though.
Is looking at the scenery really that fun？
I'm kinda sleepy... Oh, not that I'm bored or anything.
Are you thinking, 'Ah, it's spring...' or something？ You sound like an old man.
Not too hot, not too cold. That's the best.
The leaves have turned quite a bit.
It's freezing! Do something about it.
Is it really impossible to see everything on an overnight trip？
I'm tired. ...Just for a little bit.
Okay, hit me with some trivia about this place. Just kidding.
Being together for this long is...
What were we doing after this again？
...What are you staring at？ Not that I care.
Come to think of it, it's been a while since I've been on tatami.
It's a nice room, isn't it？ Really feels like a proper inn.
I brought you Valentine's chocolate. Here. I am your girlfriend, after all.
Thanks! That makes me really happy.
...It's nothing to get that worked up over. It's just what you do on days like this.
Maybe, but I'm honestly just happy to get some from you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Well, in that case, I guess waiting in line to buy it was worth it...
You went to all that trouble for me.
Well, I was already out shopping for other stuff. ...It just happened to catch my eye...
Got it, thanks. Looks like ● will have to go all out for White Day, too.
...Oh right, that's a thing too. Got it, yeah. I'll be counting on you, then.
Oh... Trying to play it cool won't work. Rinko sees right through you.
Wait, is this about Valentine's Day？
It'd be pretty sad if you had a girlfriend and still didn't get anything, right？ So...
You're not giving it to me？
It kind of bugs me to just hand it over, so say, 'Please! Give me some chocolate, Lady Rinko!'
(Is she just trying to hide her embarrassment？)
